title: Live STT - provider leg connection errors

model.expr: sum by (provider) (increase(omi_stt_provider_connect_total{job="backend-listen-metrics",outcome="failure"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (provider) (increase(omi_stt_provider_connect_total{job="backend-listen-metrics"}[5m])), 1) unless on (provider) (max by (provider) (omi_stt_provider_retired{job="backend-listen-metrics"} == 1))

annotations.summary: Live STT - provider leg connection errors
annotations.user_impact: A provider fails more than half of its connection attempts (after any typed error class); surviving sessions depend on the remaining tail. Retired providers (intentionally unfunded, e.g. hosted Deepgram) are excluded via omi_stt_provider_retired.

annotations.verification: Hermetic rule contract checked; the metric name is also asserted to be emitted in backend source. No production Prometheus evaluation or notification delivery performed.

annotations.evaluated_bad: Synthetic contract: one provider with 100 connect attempts and a 100% failure ratio in 5m (any error class).
annotations.evaluated_good: Synthetic contract: one provider with 100 connect attempts and a 0% failure ratio in 5m.

title: Live transcription working for under 90% of sessions

annotations.summary: Live transcription is working for under 90% of sessions that should have produced a transcript.
annotations.user_impact: Roughly one in ten or more live sessions ended with no transcript at all - the 2026-09-26 incident shape (whole chain degraded for hours without a page on the user outcome).
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_live_session_transcript_outcome_total, emitted exactly once per backend-STT listen session at teardown (all three outcome children are pre-created at process start). too_short sessions (under 10s of audio or no VAD speech) are excluded from the denominator; custom-STT sessions are not counted.
annotations.verification: Hermetic rule contract checked; the metric name is also asserted to be emitted in backend source. No production Prometheus evaluation or notification delivery performed.
annotations.safe_next_action: Open the Backend-listen dashboard Live transcription health row: check the per-provider success panels and breaker-open gauges, then inspect provider account state (top up balance) before touching routing.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Synthetic incident shape: no transcribed series and a sustained near-zero success ratio; a 20x reconnect storm creates many no_transcript WebSocket outcomes, which increase the denominator and cannot dilute the ratio. At >=50 outcomes per 5m, the condition remains true and fires after 10m.
annotations.evaluated_good: Synthetic contract: 99 of 100 counted sessions transcribed; zero counted sessions stays healthy because the volume guard is false.

title: Live STT - managed leg duplicate settlement

annotations.summary: Live STT - managed leg duplicate settlement
annotations.user_impact: Duplicate settlement accounting may corrupt routing evidence; inspect serving outcome metrics separately.
annotations.scope: Per instance and target, settled must not exceed handed-off opened legs. Transport release and settlement are independent; opened-minus-settled-minus-open is diagnostic only.
annotations.verification: Hermetic rule contract checked; no production Prometheus evaluation or notification delivery performed.
annotations.safe_next_action: HOLD routing qualification and investigate duplicate settlement. Do not roll back serving solely for opened-minus-settled-minus-open; compare transcript, terminal-after-text and exhausted-chain outcomes with baseline.
annotations.threshold: Settled minus opened >0 for 2m per instance and target. Grafana pending time supplies elapsed persistence; missing series are not proof of healthy accounting.
annotations.evaluated_bad: More managed settlements than handed-off legs on the same instance/target, sustained for 2m.
annotations.evaluated_good: Settled at most opened. This does not prove complete settlement: released-but-unsettled state and oldest age require direct instrumentation before omission alerts can qualify a rollout.

title: Live STT - sustained new managed leg settlement gap

annotations.summary: Live STT - sustained new managed leg settlement gap
annotations.user_impact: A sustained new settlement accounting gap may omit routing evidence; compare serving outcomes before any rollback.
annotations.scope: Per instance and target: opened minus settled minus currently open, above the nonnegative same-series carry-in one hour earlier. Live legs are subtracted; unchanged control debt does not page.
annotations.verification: Hermetic rule contract checked; no production Prometheus evaluation or notification delivery performed.
annotations.safe_next_action: HOLD routing qualification and investigate pending settlement ownership. Record both arms and their carry-in; compare transcript, terminal-after-text and exhausted-chain outcomes. Do not roll back serving for this accounting proxy alone.
annotations.threshold: Positive accounting gap above its nonnegative one-hour carry-in for 15m of Grafana pending time. Missing historical series uses a label-matched zero baseline for new instances; missing current components remain no data.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Run 5b shape: 29 opened, 24 settled, 4 open gives a new +1 above zero carry-in, sustained for at least 15m.
annotations.evaluated_good: Balanced in-flight legs, negative gaps, unchanged positive control carry-in and transients shorter than 15m stay clear. The rolling one-hour baseline ages out old debt; this warning is not a complete released-but-unsettled inventory.

title: Live STT - capacity_full exhausting live sessions

annotations.summary: More than 15% of accepted /v4/listen sessions per 15m end with an exhausted capacity_full failover into one failover target
annotations.threshold: per to_mode: exhausted capacity_full fallbacks / listen-accepted > 0.15 with >= 100 accepted sockets in 15m, for 30m
annotations.user_impact: Sessions lose live transcription because the failover target had no room or the replay ring overflowed; clients fall back to offline sync.
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_fallback_total{reason=capacity_full,outcome=exhausted} by to_mode over omi_listen_accepted_total. capacity_full covers several limits; the bounded log field subtype= (admission, buffer_cap, span_cap, replay_ring_cap, queue_timeout, unknown) on omi_fallback_event says which tripped.
annotations.verification: Backtest 2026-10-12..10-19 (7d, 5m steps, prod Prometheus via Grafana proxy): to_mode=parakeet p50 0.037 / p90 0.09 / p99 0.168 / max 0.206; soniox max 0.089; modulate max 0.035; unavailable max 0.108. At > 0.15 for 30m it fires twice in 7d, both parakeet (10-14 18:22Z, 10-15 17:22Z, during the known window-capacity periods). At 2026-10-19 14:05Z parakeet was 0.043.
annotations.safe_next_action: Group recent omi_fallback_event reason=capacity_full log lines by subtype=. admission means the window-admission cap (listen pods x per-pod cap); replay_ring_cap/buffer_cap are session-local replay limits, not pod or GPU capacity. Only raise capacity for admission.

title: Live STT - provider terminal failures per leg are high

annotations.summary: Live STT terminal failures on one provider exceed 75% of its successful leg connects in 15m
annotations.threshold: per provider: omi_live_stt_terminal_failures_total / successful omi_stt_provider_connect_total > 0.75 with >= 30 successful connects in 15m, for 30m
annotations.user_impact: Legs on this provider connect fine and then die. The connect-error alerts cannot see this because handshakes succeed.
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_live_stt_terminal_failures_total (all phases/outcomes) by provider over omi_stt_provider_connect_total{outcome=success} by provider. The outcome label is the bounded public outcome (upstream_error); the typed cause is in omi_fallback_total reason (capacity_full, connection_lost, modulate_serve_error, no_text_rescue_complete).
annotations.verification: Backtest 2026-10-12..10-19 (7d, 5m steps): modulate p50 0.181 / p90 0.50 / p99 0.768 (chronic: Modulate legs end in failover often); parakeet p50 0.012 / p90 0.207 / p99 0.794; soniox max 0.357. At > 0.75 for 30m it fires twice in 7d (modulate 10-18 05:32Z, parakeet 10-14 17:47Z); > 0.6 fires 5 times, > 0.5 fires 10 times. At 2026-10-19 14:05Z modulate was 0.25-0.41.
annotations.safe_next_action: Split omi_fallback_total{from_mode=<provider>} by reason and the fallback log subtype= before touching provider credentials or capacity.

title: Live STT - sessions exhausting the provider chain above 8% for an hour

annotations.summary: More than 8% of accepted /v4/listen sessions exhausted every live STT provider over the last hour
annotations.threshold: omi_stt_chain_exhausted_total / omi_listen_accepted_total over 60m > 0.08 with >= 600 accepted sockets in 60m, for 20m
annotations.user_impact: Those sessions lose live transcription entirely until the client reconnects; audio falls back to offline sync.
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_stt_chain_exhausted_total (all demand cohorts) over omi_listen_accepted_total. This is the session-level exhaustion counter, not the stt_selection fallback count that omi-stt-chain-exhausted-warn (> 0.35) uses. The series is incremented only on the configured chain (STT_CONNECT_ORDER_FROM_CONFIG, utils/stt/live_chain.py), which prod runs: 120 live series across 3 demand cohorts on 2026-10-20; it is empty on any deployment without the configured chain.
annotations.verification: Backtest (prod Prometheus via the Grafana proxy). 20m window, 2026-10-10..10-20, 5m steps: daily p50 0.035-0.131 (10-20 is 0.035, the post-fix baseline), so a 5%/20m rule would fire 62x in 10d. 60m window, 2026-10-17..10-20, 10m steps: > 0.08 sustained 20m fires 6x in 3d (10-17 19:17Z, 10-18 00:07Z, 10-19 10:17Z, 10-19 15:17Z, 10-20 00:27Z, 10-20 15:07Z), including the 10-20 Soniox-bench incident (0.085-0.097 from 15:07Z). A dynamic threshold (2x the median of the same hour 1d/2d/7d ago, floor 0.08) was evaluated and rejected: the 3-offset query takes ~17s per instant evaluation (the 7-offset p50 8-29s, near the 30s evaluation timeout), and it would NOT have fired on 10-20 because the prior days were degraded at that hour (baseline 0.07-0.11).
annotations.safe_next_action: Check omi_stt_cost_routing_stage by target first: if no target is at 100 the router is in its availability escape (see omi-stt-no-full-stage-target). Then split omi_fallback_total{outcome=exhausted} by from_mode/to_mode/reason before touching provider config or rolling listen.

title: Live STT - no provider at stage 100 (router availability escape)

model.expr: (count((min by (target) (omi_stt_cost_routing_stage{job="backend-listen-metrics"}) == 100) or (max by (target) (omi_stt_cost_routing_stage{job="backend-listen-metrics"}) != max by (target) (omi_stt_cost_routing_stage{job="backend-listen-metrics"}))) or vector(0)) and on () (count(omi_stt_cost_routing_stage{job="backend-listen-metrics"}) > 0)

annotations.summary: No live STT target has been at cost-routing stage 100 for 10m, so the router serves every session from its availability escape
annotations.threshold: count of targets whose fleet-min omi_stt_cost_routing_stage is 100 (or NaN, a pristine GateState) == 0, while the stage gauge is present, for 10m
annotations.user_impact: With every target in trial or benched, each session gets all available targets ordered by stage, so trial and benched providers (e.g. Modulate at stage 0) serve real sessions and chain exhaustion rises.
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_stt_cost_routing_stage by target (live_router.py availability escape: all(stage < 100) for available targets). NaN means a pristine GateState (stage 100) and counts as full.
annotations.verification: Backtest 2026-10-10..10-20 (2m steps): 11 episodes over 10m in 10d (10-13 08:11Z 238m, 10-13 18:15Z 38m, 10-14 17:05Z 70m, 10-14 19:29Z 300m, 10-15 20:31Z 96m, 10-16 01:03Z 94m, 10-16 05:57Z 134m, 10-16 19:05Z 226m, 10-18 00:45Z 62m, 10-19 23:29Z 138m, 10-20 13:45Z 70m). The 10-20 13:45Z episode is the Soniox bench after the 13:37Z listen roll, which ended when the Soniox GateState keys were reset at 14:53Z.
annotations.evaluated_good: 1 target at stage 100 (soniox, 2026-10-20 15:00Z)
annotations.safe_next_action: Read omi_stt_cost_routing_stage by target and the live_stt_gate bench/stage log lines. If a target was benched by a restart burst rather than its own failure rate, the documented lever is saving and resetting that target's GateState keys (data/run-2026-10-13-two-lane-nemotron/stt-degradation-2026-10-20.md); never roll listen at peak to clear it.

title: Live STT - local delivery deaths exhausting live sessions

annotations.summary: More than 2% of accepted /v4/listen sessions per 15m end exhausted after a local delivery death (send_queue_full, replay_send_stalled, delivery_expired)
annotations.threshold: exhausted local-delivery fallbacks / listen-accepted > 0.02 with >= 100 accepted sockets in 15m, for 30m
annotations.user_impact: Sessions lose live transcription because our own send path to the vendor backed up (pacing/catch-up), not because a vendor refused; clients fall back to offline sync.
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_fallback_total{component=stt_live_session,reason=~send_queue_full|replay_send_stalled|delivery_expired,outcome=exhausted} over omi_listen_accepted_total. Sibling of omi-stt-capacity-full-exhausted: since P34 (#23074, train P 2026-10-21 22:24Z) these local deaths no longer report capacity_full, so that rule no longer sees them.
annotations.verification: Backtest on prod Prometheus, 15m steps. Post-P34 pre-#23147 (2026-10-21 22:40Z..10-22 03:10Z, the replay-pacing bug live): ratio p50 0.039, max 0.060, up to 32 exhausted per 15m; at > 0.02 for 30m it fires through that window. Post-#23147 live-tail catch-up (10-22 03:40Z..08:00Z): p50 0.000, max 0.012; does not fire. Peak re-check 2026-10-22 08-16Z incl. the 14-16Z peak (386-1,021 accepted/15m): p50 0.000, p90 0.0033, max 0.0047; lowered 0.03 -> 0.02 (4x above that max, half the broken median).
annotations.evaluated_bad: 0.060 (2026-10-22 pre-#23147, replay pacing at 1.0x into an equal wall)
annotations.safe_next_action: Split by reason and from_mode: sum by (reason, from_mode) (increase(omi_fallback_total{component="stt_live_session",reason=~"send_queue_full|replay_send_stalled|delivery_expired"}[15m])). Read the per-death WARNING 'Soniox local delivery death subtype=... queue_age_seconds since_last_send_seconds' lines: large since_last_send with a full queue means the writer was starved (pod pressure); small means the vendor socket stopped accepting. Check LISTEN_LIVE_TAIL_CATCHUP_RATE and replay wall (omi_stt_replay_wall_seconds) before touching capacity.
